---
title: "6 · Generative Models"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Learning a probability distribution from data and drawing new samples from it. The probability toolkit: distributions and densities, expectations as averages over samples, the Gaussian, joint, conditional and marginal distributions, Bayes' rule, the Kullback–Leibler divergence and maximum likelihood. Latent-variable models and the variational autoencoder: the latent space, the reparametrisation trick, the evidence lower bound; conditional generation of a chosen digit or cell type, checked by a classifier. Generative adversarial networks, the best discriminator and the Wasserstein distance; diffusion models, the forward process, the reverse step and the score. Spin configurations of the Ising model generated at a chosen temperature and checked against Monte Carlo.
